author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-10-04 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Like Paul, I long to depart.
context_before: Believe me, for God’s pattern of salvation has unfolded in me. The divine drama has reached its climax. Only Caesar’s history continues, and every child born of woman is fulfilling it. Moving across the screen of space for thousands of years, man experiences moments of joy and sorrow, sadness and pain, until the dramatic story of Christ unfolds from within. It takes 1260 days from God’s first mighty act to the final one. Then, if the brothers decide it is your task to remain and tell the story, you will.
context_after: I feel as though there is a thorn in my side and I pray to have it removed. But I will remain, knowing my grace is sufficient, for my power is made perfect in weakness.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Power And Wisdom (1968-10-04).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-10-04 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: He who misses me injures himself.
context_before: Personified as a little child, wisdom says: “He who finds me, finds life and receives favor from the Lord.
context_after: He who hates me loves death.” One day, finding life in yourself, you will hold wisdom in your arms and receive favor from the Lord. But if you would rather have more of the world of Caesar, you will hate the idea of the child, because you love death.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Power And Wisdom (1968-10-04).
